data.long_meaning: The name Piklu is derived from the Bengali language, which means 'small mango'. This name is often given to a baby girl born during the mango season, symbolizing the joy and happiness that comes with the arrival of the fruit. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Bengali. Parents who choose Piklu usually hope their child will grow to embody small mango and live with faith, good character and purpose.
